speaker: narrator
text: For a while, the secret was safe. But one day, Luna's power sparkled out of her hands by mistake — right in the middle of class. Her teacher saw it. And her teacher was not kind. "So," said the teacher, with a cold little smile. "You're the girl with the powers. I think I'll keep you." The teacher locked the classroom door. But she forgot one thing: Luna could open ANY door.

speaker: narrator
text: Cheeto wiggled his ears — bzzzt! — and the lock popped open. Then Luna did something amazing. She took a deep breath... and turned into a tiger! A real, stripy, springy tiger. Luna the tiger and Cheeto the bunny raced down the hall and dived into a tiny silver escape pod.

speaker: narrator
text: said Luna, and she pressed the big green button. But the pod gave a wobble and a fizz. Something went wrong. The map glitched — and the little pod shot off the WRONG way.
